The plate cites two verses and sets twelve terms; neither verse has twelve. Rev. v. 12 gives seven — power, riches, wisdom, strength, honour, glory, blessing — and v. 13 four, all already among the seven. Five are therefore from elsewhere in the book: *might* and *thanksgiving* stand together at Rev. vii. 12, and *salvation* in the cry at Rev. vii. 10, whose own words — *unto our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb* — are the two lines this grid runs into. The Apocalypse's own lists run to seven, twice; this one runs to twelve, and the page does not say why.
